CITY OF LA VERNE

  ADJOURNED MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Robin Carder, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Muir Davis, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member  La Verne, CA 91750

  Monday, November 16, 2020, 5 p.m.

Tonight’s Council Study Session on Short Term Rentals will be closed to the public in compliance with Governor
Newsom’s Executive Order to minimize the spread of the COVID-19 Virus. The City encourages public
participation in the study session and offers the following options which are available for the public to participate.

1. Individuals can email their comments to the Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org by noon on
  the day of the meeting. Those comments will be shared with City Council in advance of the City Council
  meeting and included as part of the permanent record. Please be advised that public comments
  submitted by emails or any other format to the City Clerk and City Council are public records and will
  be made available for public viewing.

2. Individuals who wish to share their comments directly during the meeting may do so by emailing the
  Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org with their phone number and the item(s) they wish to
  speak on. Requests will be accepted before and throughout the meeting and staff will call you back at the
  appropriate time. Once items are considered by the City Council, no further public comment on that matter
  will be accepted. A time limit of 3-minutes is set for all public comments.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification or
accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726
at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Monday of every month.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  2.  ROLL CALL: Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Davis, Mayor
  Pro Tem Carder and Mayor Hepburn.
 3. Council Study Session - The City Council will meet with staff for a study session on Short Term
  Rentals.

4. ADJOURNMENT

  THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING of the La Verne City Council
  is scheduled for Monday, December 7, 2020, at 6:30 p.m.

  To minimize the spread of the COVID-19 Virus and to keep the
  community safe, the Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony will be held virtually
  at 6:30 p.m. Watch live at www.cityoflaverne.org/stream.

  The La Verne City Council thanks the community
  for taking all the precautions to prevent the spread of COVID-19.

  Posting Statement: On November 10, 2020, a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on the
  bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
  cityoflaverne.org.

  It is my understanding that the current Ordinance was established to address and ensure the

  The current Short Term Exemption Application is questionable. As described in real estate law, " the
  grantee or tenant of an estate in real property will be able to possess the premises in peace, without

  The Short Term Rental Exemption Application in item 1 . requests " signatures of area

Violation points within any 12 month period should result in the revocation of the City' s
permit to rent short term and a suspension of the Business License for 1 year.

I ask you to consider each of the the following points in establishing a " Good Neighbor Policy" to
regulate short- term rentals, irrespective of if it is a bedroom or an entire house, in our city.

  GOOD NEIGHBOR POLICY

1.  All short term rentals must have a current City of La Verne Business License and post the license
number on any and all advertisements along with their Transient Occupancy Tax (" TOT") number.
2. All short term rentals must have a local owner, property manager or responsible party that can
respond to any urgent police request or emergency within 30 minutes.
3. All rentals must be properly insured for liability purposes as a rental. Proof of liability
insurance must be presented with an application for a Business License.
4. All rentals must have properly functioning smoke and carbon monoxide detectors along with an
easily accessible fire extinguisher.
5. Any property with a pool must have a self closing gate to the pool area. Any and all doors leading
directly into an area around a pool should have a door alarm with a chime when opened.
6. Guests with pets must obey leash laws and pick up after their animals.
7.  No use of any illicit drugs.
8.  Use of alcohol responsibly.
9. No outdoor amplified music that may be heard past the property line or parties.
10. Rental of individual bedrooms without the owner residing on premises is prohibited unless
permitted and licensed as a motel, hotel or " bed and breakfast."
11 . If the premises are not owner occupied, rental of a bedroom in an apartment or condominium
must be allowed under the master rental agreement between the owner and tenant. If owner
occupied,  short term rentals must not be restricted under the HOA.
12. The " Good Neighbor Policy" should be posted inside the entrance door to a rented room or main
door to a house if the entire place is rented.
13. If a guest violates any of the above or there are legitimate violations such at loud music etc.
confirmed by complaints to the Police Department, the owner will be immediately notified and must
respond to the property within 30 minutes. Three violations issued to guests at a subjeCt property
within a 12 month period and the property' s Business License for the short - term rentals
will be revoked for 1 year. The revocation will apply to all short-term rentals at the subject
property in the instance where more than 1 bedroom is rented.
I believe the suggested Good Neighbor Policy is comprehensive and addresses the concerns of
neighbors as well as short term rental owners while holding the short term rental host ( property owner
or tenant) responsible and accountable with penalties for non- compliance.

Thank you for your consideration.  Kindly confirm receipt.

 Respectfully,

 Linda Lockhart Wilkinson
